propositions: Release and packaging tests fail to collect under non-editable install (uv pip install '.[dev,...]') because they derive repo root via Path(installed_package.__file__).parents[N], which resolves to site-packages/lib instead of the checkout.

The sweep's declared lower-bound resolution leg fails with TypeError: Field project.license-files must be a table because the hatchling floor (>=1.18) predates PEP 639 license-files table support (added in >=1.27).
Tests assuming editable layout fail on the sweep (macos, full suite) and sweep (declared lower-bound resolution) legs, which are not marked continue-on-error and represent supported configurations.

The fix involves making tests locate the repo root install-agnostically (e.g. via marker walk from test file location) and raising the hatchling floor to >=1.27 to accept current license-files declaration.
